trait.name: Helpful
entries: The expert can take the Help action as a bonus action, and the creature who receives the help gains a {@dice 1d6} bonus to the {@dice d20} roll. If that roll is an attack roll, the creature can forgo adding the bonus to it, and then if the attack hits, the creature can add the bonus to the attack's damage roll against one target.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: When the expert is not {@condition incapacitated} and subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it failed.

trait.name: Tools
entries: The expert has thieves' tools and a musical instrument.

action.name: Extra Attack
entries: The expert can attack twice, instead of once, whenever it takes the attack action on its turn.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.
